head_commit.message:
Add compact transcript browsing and prompt navigation to the TUI (#46739)

## What changed

- Make double `Esc` enter compact prompt browsing in the owned transcript view and inline overlay. Use left/right arrows to select prompts, up/down arrows to scroll, `Ctrl+T` to toggle details, and `Enter` to rewind and edit. `Esc` cancels browsing and restores the original reading position and presentation.
- Add a responsive browsing footer, a pinned prompt header for answer context, and contextual composer tips that respect `show_tooltips` and configured shortcuts.
- Load older history as prompt navigation needs it, preserve the selected prompt across pagination, and resolve rewind requests by cell identity. Reject remote prompt restoration when it contains local image paths or command syntax.
- Bound initial owned-transcript history loading to a budget of three screenfuls plus an item scan limit, independently of terminal scrollback settings.

## Testing

Add regression tests and snapshots for browsing, rewind, cancellation after resize and pagination, custom key bindings, search and selection precedence, offline input, prompt headers, composer tips, and history hydration.

head_commit.message:
Add selection and copying to the transcript viewer (#46732)

## What changed

- Add mouse selection, word and line selection, drag autoscrolling, and keyboard selection with `Ctrl+Space`. Support copying selected text and opening links with a modified click.
- Anchor reading positions and selections to source text so resizing, streaming completion, and history pagination preserve the displayed content. Preserve hard line breaks, indentation, tabs, and graphemes when copying, while excluding display gutters and soft wraps.
- Rejoin activity groups split across history pages while retaining the reader's displayed revision.
- Distinguish confirmed clipboard writes from unconfirmed terminal requests, and retain native clipboard ownership after the transcript overlay closes.
- Manage mouse capture and keyboard modes across overlay transitions, editor handoffs, and suspend/resume.

head_commit.message:
Render dynamic tool activity and preserve TUI history ordering (#46731)

## Why

The TUI ignored dynamic tool items, and replayed tool activity could differ from live output. Concurrent tool completion also needs to preserve transcript order when writing to terminal scrollback.

## What changed

- Retain dynamic tool rows, update them when calls finish out of order, and mark unfinished calls interrupted when a turn ends.
- Queue terminal output behind unfinished dynamic tools and drain settled rows in bounded batches. Preserve queued output through stream consolidation, resize, and rollback without emitting it twice.
- Align replayed file changes, MCP results, and exploration groups with live rendering. Keep hidden reasoning and terminal interaction details within compatible activity groups, and preserve finalized plan fragments.
- Ignore stale history-page responses, bound turn metadata requests to missing turns, and insert older history after session headers. Keep hidden review prompts as activity-group boundaries.

## Testing

Add regression tests and snapshots for out-of-order tool completion, interruption, ordered scrollback emission, rollback, deferred usage updates, replay consistency, overlapping history, and repeated hidden prompts.

Cancel pending transcript Home jumps on subsequent navigation (#46722)

## Why

Pressing `Home` while older transcript history is loading leaves a pending jump to the beginning. Subsequent navigation should supersede that jump so arriving history does not override the user's new reading position.

## What changed

Cancel the pending jump when scrolling, jumping to the latest entry, or navigating prompts in the read-only transcript viewer. Keep the in-flight history page by switching from `LoadingBeginning` to `LoadingOlder`. Handle navigation before the first draw as well as after rendering, while preserving pending jumps during passive highlight restoration.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for navigation after `Home` before and after the first draw, checking that arriving older history preserves the expected viewport. Extend prompt backtracking tests to verify that navigation clears the pending jump.
